item.title: Hotaru-ika: Toyama Bay's Glowing Firefly Squid — Guide
item.description: Hotaru-ika, or firefly squid, are small bioluminescent squid that rise from the depths of Toyama Bay to the surface in vast numbers each spring, an event considered one of the bay’s signature natural phenomena and best experienced on a pre-dawn boat tour off the Namerikawa coast, where the glowing squid can sometimes be seen washing up along the shoreline itself. The season is also celebrated with a dedicated Hotaru-ika Squid Festival each spring, and the squid itself is served across Toyama as a seasonal delicacy, typically boiled and dressed with vinegar-miso sauce.
